name: scry
description: Self-hosted Google Search Console dashboard, REST API and MCP server on Cloudflare Workers.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the dashboard, 12+ characters. You can switch to Cloudflare Access later.

SA_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Any long random string (for example from `openssl rand -base64 48`). It encrypts the Google service account keys you upload. Keep it: changing it means re-uploading keys.

DB.description: Stores 16 months of Search Console data.

KV.description: Caches reports and Google access tokens.
